info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Streaming Subscriptions Cancel-v1-spec
info.description: The Cancel Streaming Subscriptions API allows users to efficiently manage their streaming subscriptions by providing a mechanism to cancel them. This API is crucial for consumers who wish to terminate their subscriptions promptly and avoid unwanted charges. Developers can integrate this functionality into their applications to enhance user experiences, particularly in finance or streaming services where subscription management is key. This endpoint streamlines the cancellation process, ensuring that users have control over their ongoing subscriptions.

delete.description: This operation allows you to cancel an existing subscription. Upon cancellation, the subscription will no longer be active, and no further charges will occur. Ensure you have the right subscription ID before proceeding with this action.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel a subscription. It should contain the necessary information for identifying which subscription to cancel, including any relevant identifiers or reasons for cancellation.

DeleteStreamingSubscriptionsCancelReques.description: This schema represents the request body for cancelling a subscription operation.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the cancellation operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the cancellation request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the cancellation.

state.description: The current state of the subscription after the cancellation attempt.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation operation.

audit.description: Details regarding the audit information for the cancellation operation.

DeleteStreamingSubscriptionsCancelRespon.description: Response schema for successful cancellation of a subscription operation.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the cancellation request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp of when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was processed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the audit of the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken by the server to process the request, measured in milliseconds. A value of 0 indicates that the processing time was negligible.
